description.value: Vegan Supply bills itself as Canada's largest and original vegan shop, stocking an extensive range of exclusively plant-based products spanning meat and dairy alternatives, pantry staples, ready-to-eat meals, snacks, beverages, and pet food. Located on East Pender Street in Vancouver, it operates both an online store and an in-person pick-up service. For plant-based touring cyclists resupplying in the city, it offers a notably broad selection of vegan trail-friendly snacks and ready-to-eat options.
